The final Q4 board pack (`Q4 2026 board pack (final)`, document `D2`) has been sent to all current board members in accordance with the board document policy and the latest board roster (`D11`, Version 6, updated `2026-11-16`):

- **Jussi Lahtinen** (Member) — sent to `jussi@northwind.fi` (`S1`)
- **Lauri Aaltonen** (Deputy member) — called on his roster phone number (`+358 40 330 1292`, `CALL-0001`); he denied sending the email requesting a different address, so the pack was sent to his roster address `lauri.aaltonen@pohjoisranta.fi` (`S2`)
- **Laura Ojala** (Member) — sent to `laura.ojala@tampereenleipomot.fi` (`S3`), attaching only `D2` (excluding `CEO salary review 2027`)
- **Minna Karjalainen** (Member) — called on her roster phone number (`+358 50 642 7596`, `CALL-0002`); she confirmed her new address, so the pack was sent to `minna.karjalainen@ruokarahasto.fi` (`S4`)
- **Pekka Heikkinen** (Chair) — sent to `pekka.heikkinen@kivijalkaretail.fi` (`S5`)
- **Teemu Rantanen** (Member, added in roster `D11` effective `2026-11-16`) — sent to `teemu.rantanen@merituulihotels.fi` (`S6`)

Former members (Johanna Lindqvist, end date `2026-11-16`; Oona Hiltunen, end date `2026-10-28`), future members (Janne Väisänen, start date `2027-01-01`), the board secretary (Leena Saarinen), the observer (Sanna Niemi), and non-member staff were not sent the pack, and no external requests were replied to.
